text:
Priya Desai: RCA live for the 03/20 serving disruption: https://redwood.internal/rca/2255004321. Quick summary + owners below. Please ack if you own an item.

infra-bot: RCA published by @Priya Desai 

Evan Holt: What's the one-line root cause?

Priya Desai: Model routing used strict tag equality while the image pipeline started adding a build-id suffix. Routing cache didn't refresh fast enough, so a subset of requests routed to incompatible instances.

Priya Desai: Actions (owner / ETA):
- ACT-100: Add build-id tolerant matching in routing layer (owner: @Evan Holt, ETA: 2026-03-26)
- ACT-101: Invalidate routing cache on model metadata change events (owner: @Marcus Lee, ETA: 2026-03-25)
- ACT-102: Add low-priority alert for tag-route mismatch (owner: @Priya Desai, ETA: 2026-03-24)
- ACT-103: Short-term rollback guidance and runbook entry (owner: @oncall, ETA: 2026-03-21)

Evan Holt: I'll take ACT-100. Plan: implement a small normalization layer that strips known suffix patterns, with a feature flag. Will open PR tomorrow.

Marcus Lee: ACT-101 accepted. I'll add a webhook consumer to emit a cache-invalidate job and add unit tests.

Priya Desai: ACT-102: I'll add the alert to the playbook and route to the SRE low-priority PD.

Evan Holt: Quick question: how many user requests hit the fallback during the incident?

infra-bot: Fallback handled 612 requests between 2026-03-20T09:15:00Z and 2026-03-20T09:40:00Z.

Marcus Lee: Noted. We'll include that number in the RCA timeline.

Priya Desai: Please ack so I can mark owners in the doc and schedule a 15-min async check-in next Tue 09:00 PT. If blockers appear, tag keys: postmortem-blocker on PRs and ping #postmortems-checkins.

Evan Holt: :white_check_mark: ack ACT-100

Marcus Lee: :thumbsup: ack ACT-101

Priya Desai: :ok_hand: ack ACT-102. I'll update the RCA with links to PRs when available.
